+### Deterministic release-prerequisite recovery
+
+Run only when canonical regeneration is explicitly authorized, from
+`D:\linkedin-visual-labs-git\linkedin-visual-labs` using its existing `.venv`:
+
+```powershell
+& ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -B -m linkedin_visual_labs monopoly recover-release
+```
+
+The recovery command requires branch `project/p05-traffic-operations-early-warning`,
+the tracked `configs/p02_monopoly_ai.yaml`, 10,000 games and master seed 73031.
+It always recomputes the tournament and a second complete replay. No force mode,
+reduced replay, seed override, arbitrary destination, package installation or MP4
+encoding is provided. Simulation, selection, validation and rendering semantics
+remain in their existing modules.
+
+Preflight checks tracked Fluent artwork/license/notice, guarded destinations and
+both regular and bold fonts through the unchanged renderer selection order.
+Missing fonts fail before expensive work; nothing is downloaded. Selected font
+identities/hashes and runtime versions are recorded because pixel reproduction
+can differ across environments.
+
+Generated files remain under ignored `outputs/p02_monopoly_ai/`:
+
+- `data/`: tournament CSV, summary JSON, representative game and events JSON;
+- `validation/release_recovery_replay/`: four independently replayed data files;
+- `validation/`: tournament validation, fairness, strategy diagnostics and
+  `canonical_video_freeze.json`;
+- `step8_input_manifest.json`: exactly `representative_game` and
+  `representative_events`, using repository-relative paths;
+- `visual/v6_3d_piece_assets/`: four silver strategy sprites;
+- `visual/v5_preview_lab/`: the thirteen named V5 anchor PNGs;
+- `validation/release_recovery_receipt.json`: new reconstruction provenance and
+  the final bundle completion marker.
+
+The Step 8 manifest is published only after full-replay admission: fresh source
+hashes, replay bytes, canonical configuration, representative identities and
+validated evidence must agree. It is needed by preview rendering and is not
+itself proof of a complete visual bundle. Only successful final validation
+publishes the separate recovery receipt. Neither JSON contains wall-clock dates.
+
+This is a **validated reconstruction**, not the original release execution.
+The original untracked manifest's extra metadata, if any, was not recovered.
+The new receipt fingerprints current sources, config, outputs and fonts, and
+compares regenerated anchors against tracked historical approval hashes. A
+mismatch remains visible; no approval contract is rewritten and regenerated
+PNGs are not claimed to be the original approved bytes.
+
+An exclusive `.release_recovery.lock` prevents concurrent cooperating runs.
+An unexplained existing lock requires investigation; it is never automatically
+broken. Restart recomputes analytical stages and invalidates only the exact old
+manifest/receipt completion references. Existing file presence is not validation.
+The producers use per-file writes, not a transaction over the entire bundle.
+
+The preview renderer deletes and recreates **only** the exact generated
+`outputs/p02_monopoly_ai/visual/v5_preview_lab` directory. Recovery rejects
+redirected paths, arbitrary targets, subdirectories and unexpected contents
+before invoking that renderer. It never deletes the whole project output tree.
+
+Implementation checks use `test_release_recovery.py` synthetic evidence and
+mocked producers, with no real tournament. After separately authorized recovery,
+run the unchanged 33 release cases, then the full suite including all new tests,
+Ruff formatting/lint, strict mypy, dependency checks and Git scope review.
+Producer unit-test success alone does not restore the repository baseline.
+Do not stage generated data, preview images, replay copies, locks or receipts.
+
